blurb: Earth emerging from clouds on an open blue sky: trust, reach, and a clear next step.

direction.name: Sky Globe
direction.thesis: A bright, trustworthy service whose one big idea is a planet rising through clouds. Everything else stays calm so the globe and the headline carry the page.
direction.grid: Hero copy left, globe right at wide sizes; copy stacks above the globe on phones. Sections after the hero use a 12-column grid, content width 1120px, large vertical rhythm.
direction.hero: Full-bleed sky plate, a lit Earth that is the focal point, a foreground cloud bank along the bottom edge, white headline with the last line in a lighter tint of the sky.
direction.imagery: Art-directed layered plates (sky, cloud bank) plus one real-time or textured Earth. No stock photography, no icon-in-circle illustrations.
direction.motion: Slow globe drift and route arcs; everything else still. Reduced motion shows a static globe.
direction.voice: Plain, confident and concrete: what we do, for whom, what it costs. No hype words.
direction.signature: The Earth rising through the cloud bank, with the destination region facing the viewer.
